El Paso Bicycle Club Saturday Road Ride

El Paso, TX · Upper Valley · Road

El Paso Bicycle Club Saturday Road Ride is a road group ride in El Paso, TX. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am from Grace Gardens Event Center. About 30 miles, a group 14–16 mph, B group faster.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @elpasobicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the El Paso Bicycle Club Saturday Road Ride group ride

The club's main weekend ride. Around 30 miles with an A group at 14 to 16 mph and a faster B group. Helmets mandatory, non-members welcome. Times change through the year to chase daylight.
